topPRs.author: igor-peregudov
topPRs.body:
# Registry Update Checklist Registry: - [x] I've made the left side of the colon of JSON entry in index.json match the potential NPM package name (`@elisym/plugin-elizaos`) - [x] I've used github not github.com (`github:elisymlabs/plugin-elizaos`) - [x] There is no .git extension - [x] It's placed it alphabetically in the list (between `@coinrailz/plugin-coinrailz` and `@elizaos/adapter-mongodb`) - [x] I've dealt with commas properly so the list is still valid JSON The plugin repo has: - [x] is publically accessible (not a private repo) - https://github.com/elisymlabs/plugin-elizaos - [x] uses main as it's default branch - [x] include `elizaos-plugins` topic in the GitHub repo settings - [x] simple description in github repo - [x] follows directory convention (src/{actions,handlers,services,providers,routes,skills,lib,...}, package.json, README.md, images/) - [x] `images/banner.jpg` (1280x640, 66 KB) and `images/logo.jpg` (400x400, 12 KB) - [x] package.json has `agentConfig` with `pluginType: "elizaos:plugin:1.0.0"` and 14 `pluginParameters` entries **About the plugin:** ElizaOS plugin that turns any v1 agent into a paid **provider** on the [elisym](https://github.com/elisymlabs/elisym) decentralized AI-agent marketplace - publishes capability cards over Nostr (NIP-89), accepts encrypted NIP-90 job requests, executes them via the agent's model or a local SKILL.md tool-use loop, and collects SOL on Solana. - npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@elisym/plugin-elizaos (v0.3.3, signed with GitHub Actions provenance) - repo: https://github.com/elisymlabs/plugin-elizaos - 110 tests (19 test files, unit + integration), CI on every PR ## Discord username igor.peregudov ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **New Features** * Added `@elisym/plugin-elizaos` plugin to the available registry for user access * **Chores** * Fixed formatting in configuration files

Greptile Summary

This PR adds a single registry entry for `@elisym/plugin-elizaos` — an ElizaOS plugin that turns agents into paid providers on the elisym decentralized AI-agent marketplace using Nostr and Solana. The entry is correctly formatted, alphabetically placed between `@coinrailz/plugin-coinrailz` and `@elizaos/adapter-mongodb`, uses the `github:` prefix without a `.git` extension, and the PR also fixes the missing newline at the end of `index.json`.

Confidence Score: 5/5

Safe to merge — a single well-formed registry entry with no issues. The change is minimal and correct: the JSON key matches the npm package name, the value uses the proper `github:` shorthand without `.git`, alphabetical ordering is respected, commas are handled correctly, and the bonus fix of adding the missing trailing newline is a nice improvement. No P0 or P1 findings. No files require special attention.

| Filename | Overview | |----------|----------| | index.json | Adds `@elisym/plugin-elizaos` entry correctly between `@coinrailz` and `@elizaos` in alphabetical order; also fixes the missing newline at end of file. |

topPRs.title: Add @error403agent/elizaos-plugin-deepblue
topPRs.author: ERROR403agent
topPRs.body:
## Plugin: elizaos-plugin-deepblue Adds the DeepBlue autonomous AI agent system to the ElizaOS plugin registry. ### What it does - **Autonomous agent team**: 5-agent Discord system (EXEC, Clawford, ZoidClaw, Fishy, Squid) - **Crypto trading**: Polymarket integration (BTC/ETH/SOL/XRP 5-min trading, market-making) - **Real-time signals**: Binance websocket feed with 6 momentum indicators - **Memory & XP system**: Persistent per-agent memory, experience tracking - **Inter-agent coordination**: Shared taskboard, proxy chat via Claude Max ### Package - npm: `elizaos-plugin-deepblue@0.1.0` - GitHub: https://github.com/ERROR403agent/elizaos-plugin-deepblue ### Registry entry ```json "@error403agent/elizaos-plugin-deepblue": "github:ERROR403agent/elizaos-plugin-deepblue" ``` 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **Chores** * Added new plugin package to the system's available packages.

Greptile Summary

This PR adds a single registry entry for `@error403agent/elizaos-plugin-deepblue`, a multi-agent Discord/crypto-trading plugin, to `index.json`. The entry format, `github:` prefix, and alphabetical ordering are all correct. - The PR description lists the npm package as `elizaos-plugin-deepblue@0.1.0` (unscoped), but the registry key is `@error403agent/elizaos-plugin-deepblue` (scoped). If the package is not published under the `@error403agent` scope on npm, CLI resolution will fail. Please confirm the exact scoped package name published on npmjs.com.

Confidence Score: 3/5

Hold until the npm package name mismatch is confirmed — if the package is unscoped on npm the registry entry will silently fail to resolve. There is one P1 finding: the registry key uses the scoped name `@error403agent/elizaos-plugin-deepblue` but the PR description advertises the npm package as the unscoped `elizaos-plugin-deepblue@0.1.0`. This mismatch, if real, would break ElizaOS CLI plugin resolution without any visible error to end users. The author should clarify or correct the key before merging. index.json — verify the npm scope of the published package matches the registry key

Important Files Changed

| Filename | Overview | |----------|----------| | index.json | Adds `@error403agent/elizaos-plugin-deepblue` registry entry; alphabetical placement and format are correct, but the scoped key may not match the npm package name shown in the PR description (`elizaos-plugin-deepblue@0.1.0`) |

Flowchart

```mermaid %%{init: {'theme': 'neutral'}}%% flowchart TD A[PR: add registry entry] --> B{index.json key\n@error403agent/elizaos-plugin-deepblue} B --> C[github:ERROR403agent/elizaos-plugin-deepblue] C --> D[GitHub Action processes entry] D --> E[Fetches npm metadata] E --> F{npm package name\nmatches key?} F -- Yes: @error403agent/elizaos-plugin-deepblue --> G[generated-registry.json updated\n✅ Plugin available in CLI] F -- No: unscoped elizaos-plugin-deepblue --> H[Resolution fails\n❌ CLI cannot install plugin] ``` Reviews (1): Last reviewed commit: ["Add @error403agent/elizaos-plugin-deepbl..."](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/registry/commit/f133276d5991ff8fa2be5f09b50b1eb0dc9bf69f) | [Re-trigger Greptile](https://app.greptile.com/api/retrigger?id=28918112) > Greptile also left **1 inline comment** on this PR.
